summary.text: Belinda Fox-Spencer is the Constitution Party nominee for West Virginia's 1st District. She describes herself as a health care professional and small business owner who is not a career politician. She ran for the same seat in 2022 as an independent and says she is running on upholding the Constitution, opposing abortion, defending the Second Amendment and energy independence.

paragraphs.text: Fox-Spencer earned a high school diploma from Peterstown High School, a bachelor's degree from Bluefield State College and a bachelor's degree from Mountain State University.

She says she has 22 years of experience in health care and 32 years in small business; her 2022 campaign website said she is from Monroe County and worked in health care for 20 years as a diagnostic medical sonographer specializing in women's health.

Fox-Spencer filed as an independent candidate on July 15, 2022, after that year's primary, for the redrawn 1st District, and received 10,257 votes (4.5%) in the November 2022 general election won by Carol Miller.
Ballot Access News reports that she is the Constitution Party nominee for the district in the November 3, 2026 general election.
